subject: Chemistry
question: Calculate the volume of carbon dioxide, measured at STP, produced when 10.0 g of calcium carbonate decomposes completely. Molar volume at STP = 22.7 dm³ mol⁻¹; M(CaCO₃) = 100.09 g mol⁻¹.
response_text:
CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂, so 1 mol CaCO₃ gives 1 mol CO₂.

n(CaCO₃) = 10.0 / 100.09 = 0.0999 mol
V(CO₂) = n × V_m = 0.0999 × 22.7 = 2.27 dm³ = 2.27 × 10⁻³ m³

About 2.27 dm³ of gas is collected, assuming it behaves ideally.

correct_steps: About 2.27 dm³ of gas is collected
